summary: Initialize scoped browser outbox recovery before enabling message composers

replay.detail: Startup never submits, re-signs or retargets saved actions. Unknown delivery remains non-retryable; only explicit applied:none permits a deliberate freshly prepared child attempt.

schema.detail: Reuses the existing browser-local IndexedDB database and envelopes; no browser or server schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Live startup and chat/thread send grants wait for verified scoped storage initialization. Missing issuer remains visibly unprotected; unavailable protected storage blocks sending with a retry-later explanation instead of falling back. Restored never-dispatched thread Start and reply require original-target revalidation before dispatch.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions, re-pairing or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: A single initialization barrier per scoped connection preserves never-dispatched pending records, quarantines readable corruption, and restores unresolved dispatched records as unknown. New tabs recover independently while receipt retention can settle a demoted attempt. Drafts are not cleared by startup. No original-member correlated outcome-read capability is exposed by the current client, so unknown attempts are not reconciled or resent. Recovery entries remain discard-only; a continuation UI is not added here.
